subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how much time has passed.
source_quote: How much time has passed?” he wonders.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum has learned not to worry about how much time has passed.
source_quote: From his time as a prisoner the last time, he’s learned not to worry about how much time has passed.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is worried about being led by the Drow with Ront and Prince Derendil.
source_quote: He is worried.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum notices that the Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened tells him to relax.
source_quote: The Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum thinks not speaking Undercommon is awkward but manageable because others can translate.
source_quote: Not speaking undercommon is awkward, but then again, understanding the language of your captors may be a problem. And anyway, I’ve got plenty of folks around me who can translate.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.
source_quote: he realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum tries to steal a knife and explains he is just trying to sharpen it.
source_quote: Grygum notices a knife and tries to steal it. Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes that Shuushar has left out many details in his translations.
source_quote: Grygum again realizes that Shuushar has left out many details.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum has a peculiar expression when Buppido says the word 'divine'.
source_quote: Gyrgum has a peculiar expression as Buppido says the word divine.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum guesses that Topsy and Turvy might be better placed to steal a knife after seeing them steal food.
source_quote: Seeing how they successfully stole food, he guesses they might be better placed to steal a knife.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed that the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.
source_quote: The first thing that Zalthir noticed was that the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a spider web below which is a pool of water.
source_quote: He looks a little bit more carefully and notices a spider web. Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a stalactite across from his prison cell with a door and two bored Drow beyond it.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite. There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices a piece of paper with names of people who owe favors and pockets it.
source_quote: As the basket bounces, Zalthir notices a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper. It’s unclear where, which city, what favor, and why. But he pockets the paper.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices that Elspeth finds a comb and pockets it.
source_quote: He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices Grygum entering a cave.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning the basket to examine how to damage the winch.
source_quote: This time, though, he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.
source_quote: He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived.
source_quote: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived here.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil remembers how Ilvara greeted him upon arrival, robed in silken garments and flanked by scarred drow.
source_quote: I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck. Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her. Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realizes there is something manic about Ilvara.
source_quote: As Thorin stares at Ilvara some more, he realizes there is something manic about her.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers free-for-all conversations from his youth, with everyone shouting and not listening.
source_quote: Thorin remembers all these free-for-all conversations when he was younger. Everyone was talking over everyone, everyone was shouting, and everyone was not listening.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks via spores if Jorlan is trying to entrap them.
source_quote: Thorin connected to his friends via the spores and asked, “How do we know that he isn’t here to entrap us?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is satisfied with Jorlan’s explanation and asks, “What’s the plan?”
source_quote: Thorin is satisfied. “What’s the plan?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has a very sour expression when assigned to clean chamber pots.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool. Daz has a very sour expression.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job than he does.
source_quote: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices Zalthir and thinks the monk will have unpleasant fun cleaning up after he comes up.
source_quote: Daz notices Zalthir and thinks the monk will have some unpleasant fun cleaning up after he comes up.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices that the lake is unusually clean despite the filth being dumped into it.
source_quote: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes that the group mind created by Stool’s spores allows coordination without discovery.
source_quote: Daz notes that this allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz learns that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.
source_quote: Later, Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks, “At least we have that.”
source_quote: Daz thinks, “At least we have that.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.
source_quote: Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido projects his mind: “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”
source_quote: It’s then that Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”
source_quote: After sharing the information, Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”
source_quote: Buppido looks surprised, “We?” Thorin, who also picked up on the derro’s insanity, says, “Well, how else will we protect you so that you can fulfill the divine plan?” The derro stares at Gyrgum and says, “You are quite right. You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, “In due time.” when asked about the plan.
source_quote: Buppido, like any mysterious god or charlatan masquerading as a god, would say, “In due time.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar mutters, “Jaezred and Kalannar” when identifying the Drow.
source_quote: Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has chosen not to repeat offensive words as part of his spiritual balance.
source_quote: As part of my attempt to find spiritual balance and cope with the madness of my race, I have chosen not to repeat offensive words.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar translates every insult the Drow used.
source_quote: And then Shuushar proceeds to translate every insult the drow used.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar cautions Gyrgum, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”
source_quote: Even Shuushar seems excited, although he cautions the orc, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?”
source_quote: Jimjar, next to him, mutters, “Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar tries to make a bet: “Wanna get some action on how many buckets will be filled?”
source_quote: Jimjar again tries to make a bet, “Wanna get some action on how many buckets will be filled?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, “Wanna get in on some juicy action on how many times they’ll do this?”
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, “Wanna get in on some juicy action on how many times they’ll do this?”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar asks, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool objects to going to Gracklstugh and says, “No to the great circle! My people!”
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.”
source_quote: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “I don’t care if you succeed. I just want you to try. It will make Shoor look ridiculous, and make Ilvara realize what a terrible mistake she’s made. And if you do make a mistake, she’ll be embarrassed and need my help to find you and realize what a mistake she made.”
source_quote: Jorlan says, “I don’t care if you succeed. I just want you to try. It will make Shoor look ridiculous, and make Ilvara realize what a terrible mistake she’s made. And if you do make a mistake, she’ll be embarrassed and need my help to find you and realize what a mistake she made.”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.”
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan says, “Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.”
source_quote: Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks, “Something for later.” when seeing the spider statue’s jet eyes.
source_quote: “Something for later.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that if he were to jump into the waterfall, he could land safely into the pool below.
source_quote: He notices that if he were to jump into the waterfall, he could quite easily land safely into the pool of water below.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices Zalthir walking by while filling his bucket.
source_quote: As he fills his bucket, he notices Zalthir walking by.

subject: Stool's home
fact: Stool wants to return to his people, but the location of his home is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Buppido's divine plan
fact: Buppido claims a divine plan requires escape and distraction, but the nature of the plan is vague and unverified.
source_quote: The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.

subject: Zalthir's escape plan
fact: Zalthir considers using fire to cut the spider silk or ice to break gears, but no decision is made.
source_quote: But I breathe fire, and fire breathing is a simpler way to cut a rope…

subject: Jorlan's true motives
fact: Jorlan offers to help the prisoners escape, but his motives are unclear and unverified.
source_quote: I don’t care if you succeed. I just want you to try. It will make Shoor look ridiculous, and make Ilvara realize what a terrible mistake she’s made.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knows where their stuff is: in the chest in Ilvara’s room, and the Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers that Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool, and that’s how the waste gets processed.
source_quote: Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.
